# Mohammed Jouda (محمد جودة) | Backend & AI Integration Engineer

> محمد جودة (Mohammed Jouda) is a Backend & AI Integration Engineer specializing in Laravel, PHP, REST APIs, and practical AI integrations. مهندس تطوير خلفي وتكامل الذكاء الاصطناعي متخصص في بناء معمارية الأنظمة بـ Laravel و PHP والحلول الذكية.

## Core Projects (English)
- [AI Lead Triage & Automation System](https://www.mohammedjouda.com/projects/lead-automation): Turning unstructured incoming leads into structured business workflows with Laravel, n8n, and Gemini.
- [SprintMind AI Workspace](https://www.mohammedjouda.com/projects/sprint-mind): AI-powered agile development tool with automated story generation and sprint management.
- [AI-Powered Real-Time Messenger](https://www.mohammedjouda.com/projects/messenger): Real-time chat application with integrated AI assistance, WebSockets, and sentiment analysis.
- [Marsa Store](https://www.mohammedjouda.com/projects/marsa-store): Multi-vendor eCommerce marketplace platform with secure payments and inventory tracking.
- [Write AI](https://www.mohammedjouda.com/projects/write-ai): AI blogging platform with automated SEO content generation and publishing pipelines.
- [Techno Plus CMS](https://www.mohammedjouda.com/projects/techno-cms): Modular administrative CMS built on Laravel Filament, Livewire, and Alpine.js.
